headline: Discussed recent updates to the Unified Land Use and Development Regulations, including building height and front porch lot coverage recommendations.
summary: Ravi gave an overview of recent changes to the Unified Land Use and Development Regulations and the Building Typologies project. Recommendations included setting the height limit closer to 2.5 floors and not counting front porches in lot coverage. Approval of the previous meeting minutes was tabled to the next meeting.
decisions: Tabled approval of the previous meeting minutes to the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Approve Previous Meeting Minutes Tabled to next DRB meeting.

Discussion on Recent Updates to the Unified Land Use and Development Regulations
Ravi gave an overview of the recent changes to the Unified Land Use and Development 
Regulations, the purpose and intent of Planned Unit Development allowances, and the Building 
Typologies project, including recommendations from the report. Ravi said recommendations in 
the report included changes to the building height definition—which would set the height limit to 
be closer to 2.5 floors—and allowances for front porches to not be included in lot coverage 
calculations.
Riley asked for a track changes version. Ravi said that he can distribute links to the red-lined 
versions City Council reviewed in the prior months.
